messages: I need to seek advice from #p203# on behalf of #p206# in #m10001000#.

#p203# in #m10001000# advised that it is crucial for #p206# to convey his true feelings to his daughter, and suggested that preparing a homemade dish for her would be a great idea. Since #p206# isn't good at cooking, she asked me to deliver a recipe for a dish that #p506# would love.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I delivered the recipe written by #p203# to #p206#.
name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Advice
